scripts.dev:api: uv run --project services/api uvicorn helvetic_lens.main:app --app-dir services/api --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.build: npm run check:i18n && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run check:i18n && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.test:ai-triage: uv run --cache-dir services/api/.uv-cache --project services/api python scripts/check_ai_triage_regression.py
scripts.test:ai-triage:full: uv run --cache-dir services/api/.uv-cache --project services/api python scripts/check_ai_triage_regression.py --full
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project services/api ruff check services/api
